title: Rainforest Explorer A-Z
hook: Find the jungle clues with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one-beat cue gap with soft backing
visualStyle: friendly 3D rainforest explorer storybook, simple trail markers, leaf green and sun gold, uncluttered educational composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a curious canopy guide following movement, color, water and animal calls
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: memorable two-line thematic reset with child-compatible echo
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses vivid motion and layered habitat images—flutter, climb, slither, drip and sway—without turning into rapid patter.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 becomes stop-start call-and-response with one clean gap and a compact movement tied to the target.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
